dr_libs — single-file audio decoders
====================================

Vendored from https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs (dr_mp3.h, dr_flac.h).

Licence: public domain (Unlicense) OR MIT No Attribution (MIT-0), at your option.
See the header of each file for the full text. Permissive; safe to redistribute.

Used only by `io/AudioFile` to decode MP3 and FLAC inputs offline. Not part of the
real-time audio path. Excluded from the project's size rules (they are third-party).
